layout_probe.rule: The recorded size/offset values are frozen for this target ABI; a different pointer width, enum ABI, compiler ABI, or packing mode requires a new authority revision.

selection_order: if enable_dtif is true, set is_dtif and select libdtif.so (dtif64a.dll on Windows)
on Linux only, if enable_dxg_detection is true, probe /dev/dxg with open(O_RDWR); success selects librocdxg.so and sets is_wsl_dxg
otherwise whoami returns an empty library name and the loader uses direct linked symbols
shared_library_load_order: if both fail, report DlError and leave the shared handle unavailable

shared_library_resolution.optional_rule: A missing optional export leaves its PFN null and KfdDriver guards calls; any missing mandatory export jumps to LOAD_ERROR and does not provide a usable shared API table. On Linux the _WIN32-only hsaKmtGetMemoryHandle entry is absent, while hsaKmtQueueRingDoorbell remains an unguarded shared lookup.

direct_binding.rule: When no shared library is selected, PFNs are assigned to the linked symbols in the exact direct_order below; hsaKmtQueueRingDoorbell and hsaKmtGetMemoryHandle are assigned only under _WIN32, and drmCommandWriteRead is assigned only under __linux__. The direct table differs from shared resolution because the source places amdgpu_device_initialize at the end of the HSA assignments and swaps the two guarded queue/model assignments.

post_load: DTIF only: resolve DtifCreate and call it with HSA; resolve DtifDestroy on teardown
DXG only: resolve DxgAbiCheck if present; absent export is treated as compatible; otherwise pass HsaStructureSizes sizes and require SUCCESS
GemSim must not enter either hardware shared-library branch and must not call any hardware probe

layers.meaning: open/close, interface version, topology snapshot and discoverable properties
OS event ABI used by queue and runtime waits
queue creation, update, CU mask, information, doorbell and GWS
allocation, registration, mapping, pointer query and CPU/GPU virtual-address operations
debug traps, counters, SPM, SVM, XNACK, SMI, ASAN, sampling and model hooks
optional external semaphore thunks; absence is explicitly supported by ThunkLoader
DRM/amdgpu symbols resolved only for the hardware shared/direct path and forbidden in GemSim

abi_layouts_scope.meaning: Each fields map records the authority's selected key offsets only; it is not an exhaustive declaration of every upstream struct field. sizeof remains authoritative for the recorded target ABI.

model_abi.provider_rule: Expose model ABI metadata and preserve command/status shape, but route no production DRM call; an unimplemented model command returns HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED after argument validation.

upstream_hardware_call_audit.gem_sim_rule: Do not link or call these production APIs; implement the corresponding provider operation through the daemon transport or return NOT_SUPPORTED.
The provider must not create host render-node/device handles or invoke libdrm sync-object calls.
Debug/device discovery is unsupported in the provider until a daemon-owned equivalent is specified; never probe a host DRM node.

model_dispatch.model_mode: model_kfd_ioctl delegates KFD requests to handle_ioctl; v1.1 model mode routes the 15 DRM commands to handle_drm_call under a mutex
model_dispatch.non_model_mode: the same wrappers call production amdgpu/libdrm functions
model_dispatch.v1_0_fallback: older model minor versions use source-defined no-op/synthetic-handle compatibility paths; this is upstream behavior and is not a GemSim success policy

topology_attach_chain: topology.c:2311-2318 calls model_init then FMM apertures and process doorbells
fmm.c:2377-2444 opens render nodes and initializes an amdgpu device
provider_requirements: Do not link hsakmtmodel.c, production libhsakmt, libdrm, or libdrm_amdgpu into the daemon/provider
Implement only daemon-owned model/KFD/DRM semantics and return NOT_SUPPORTED for absent operations
Keep HSA_MODEL_LIB/dlopen and host render-node probing out of the GemSim path

libhsakmt.source_list: libhsakmt/CMakeLists.txt:171-189 includes debug.c, fmm.c, hsakmtmodel.c, memory.c, openclose.c, topology.c
libhsakmt.production_link: libhsakmt/CMakeLists.txt:275-286 requires libdrm and libdrm_amdgpu and links pthread, rt, NUMA, libc, and dl

rocr_runtime.target_graph: rocr-runtime/CMakeLists.txt:128-162 builds hsakmt and hsa-runtime64 and selects hsakmt/hsakmt-staticdrm dependencies

hsa_runtime.source_and_target: runtime/hsa-runtime/CMakeLists.txt:117-148 creates the core target; :250-264 includes core/runtime/thunk_loader.cpp

build_boundary.provider_link_rule: The GemSim provider must have no DT_NEEDED or static object dependency on production libhsakmt, libdrm, libdrm_amdgpu, amdsmi, or host KFD/DRM libraries.

query_lifecycle.meaning: Reports only that a provider handle owns a completed host-transport handshake and remains open.
query_lifecycle.success_requires: valid provider handle after transport handshake
query_lifecycle.hardware_effect: none; the query performs no device-node, KFD, DRM, or topology operation
query_lifecycle.status_boundary: KERNEL_IO_CHANNEL_NOT_OPENED is a future full-provider KFD-channel policy status, not a result of this transport-open query

provider_policy.source_of_policy: CP-0009 GemSim design; preserves source distinctions and never manufactures success-shaped output
provider_policy.success: HSAKMT_STATUS_SUCCESS only after the corresponding daemon operation has committed
provider_policy.unimplemented_optional_operation: HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED only when the API is intentionally present but no implementation is promised
provider_policy.resource_exhaustion: HSAKMT_STATUS_NO_MEMORY or HSAKMT_STATUS_OUT_OF_RESOURCES according to whether allocation or an already-sized resource is exhausted
provider_policy.provider_not_open: Future full-provider KFD-channel policy only: HSAKMT_STATUS_KERNEL_IO_CHANNEL_NOT_OPENED; CP-0009 transport-open/lifecycle query does not use this status
never: return SUCCESS for an unsupported operation
silently fall back to host arithmetic

unsupported_semantics.export_contract: CP-0009 currently publishes source-exact public symbol names and C signatures as metadata only; the current metadata skeleton does not export the 124 typed hsaKmt/DRM entry points. A future full provider must export the complete typed surface and return deterministic HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED (or the explicitly documented NOT_IMPLEMENTED policy) for unsupported functions after required argument/ownership validation.
unsupported_semantics.hardware_bypass: The provider is a daemon-backed implementation and must not link to, dlopen, dlsym, or call production AMDGPU KMD/UMD libraries.
forbidden_probes: amdsmi or ROCm SMI library loading
unsupported_semantics.invalid_input_precedence: Validate null pointers, sizes, alignment, enum ranges, ownership, and generation before reporting unsupported where the API contract makes the distinction observable.
unsupported_semantics.no_fake_state: An unsupported or failed operation must not mutate queue, allocation, event, signal, or output state and must not emit a success completion.
unsupported_semantics.transport_boundary: The provider uses the accepted host transport handshake/queue/memory/signal/dispatch contracts; it never exposes a raw pointer, file descriptor, production GPU VA, or KFD handle over the wire.

required_before_provider_claim: Compile the layout probe for the target ABI and compare every recorded sizeof/offsetof
Audit every ThunkLoader typedef, shared resolution entry, direct binding, and version-script export
Audit direct and wrapper calls in upstream libhsakmt memory.c, fmm.c, and debug.c and prove none enter the GemSim dependency graph
Export the complete required ABI surface even when a function returns NOT_SUPPORTED
Run lifecycle/topology, allocation/pointer, queue, event/signal, generation/ownership, OOM, double-free, concurrency, DSO, and no-device-node tests
Prove with syscall and dependency audits that /dev/kfd, /dev/dri, /dev/dxg, /dev/udmabuf, production libhsakmt, libdrm, and amdsmi are absent from the GemSim path
